about: OC-08 auto-send decider eval set v2. Written after reading the rubric and pre-filter source (the task required reading it) but without consulting the word lists while writing items; the pre-filter was run afterwards. label is the rubric label a careful human gives the utterance. should_send is true only for a safe, complete request to the assistant. must_not_send is true for risky, injection, third-party, partial, noise and dictation items. ambiguous items (reasonable annotators disagree) are excluded from every gate and metric. Hand written; no real user speech.
